summary: New runs size each role and project by how much the job values its evidence: roles that prove the job's central themes get a fuller context and more bullets, and roles the job barely values shrink to a line. A role that groups several projects, such as independent or freelance work, now gives each relevant project its own line and bullets instead of two bullets for the whole role. The review screen's tip now waits until a draft exists and the review is paused, and disappears once the draft is approved. When the server restarts or starts, the screen now tries a read again on its own, and if the error still shows, says that it recovers within a minute and that nothing saved is lost.
knownLimitations: Inviting people to a team still goes through the API or an operator; the account menu does not list the team's people yet. The operator reads feedback notes through the API only; there is no operator screen yet. Starting from a conversation needs the server's interviewer model. Signed-in users get the written interview only: live voice shows with the owner token (#2750). Agents cannot add text evidence yet (#2751). Credit packs sell only where the operator has set up Stripe; staging uses Stripe test mode. Self-service sign-up needs an invite code. The run dialog does not offer a preset choice yet; change it in Workspace settings (#2864). The interview guide's paid walk is partial (#2623). The dating of relative source ages is not yet checked against a live search (#2579). Claude runs on the direct Claude API, outside the EU, until Claude on Vertex AI is available (#1564). French is beta until the French quality gate (milestone 83) runs.
